notes.title: 🛠️ Weekly Update #10 – Fixes, Optimizations & Future Plans
notes.notes:
[h1]🛠️ Weekly Update #10 – Fixes, Optimizations & Future Plans[/h1][p]This week’s update is all about stability, performance, and preparing the ground for the next content push. While we’re fixing and polishing, we’re also teasing what’s next – more items, new quests, and even a peek into a brand-new project.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]🔧 Fixes & Improvements[/h2][p]• [b]Translation errors fixed[/b] – several localization issues corrected.
• [b]Resolution handling fixed[/b] – game now properly detects screen resolution.
• [b]Data cleanup[/b] – removed unnecessary data, resulting in ~3% less CPU/RAM/GPU usage.
• [b]GPU baseline clarified[/b] – Unreal Engine requires a minimum GPU load; we’ve now optimized around this limit.
• [b]Windows 10 loading fix[/b] – main menu now always creates and loads a Savefile correctly.
• [b]Sound bug fixed[/b] – no more random audio glitches.
• [b]Quest tracking improved[/b] – progress is now updated more reliably.
• [b]Achievement sync fixes[/b] – Steam achievements now unlock instantly after claiming a quest.
• [b]Inventory notifications polished[/b] – clearer pop-ups when full.
• [b]Scratch It display fixed[/b] – tickets now always render correctly.
• [b]Casino odds correction[/b] – rounding errors in minigames fixed.
• [b]Shop discount fix[/b] – discounts now display and apply properly.
• [b]Arena status display fixed[/b] – monster health bars update in real time.
• [b]UI scaling tweaks[/b] – cleaner look across different screen sizes.
• [b]Performance spike reduction[/b] – smoother transitions between tabs (Arena, Shop, Casino).[/p][p]
[/p][h2]📦 What’s Next[/h2][p]We’re preparing a bigger content update coming soon:
• 10 [b]new items[/b]
• 5 [b]new crafting recipes[/b]
• Fresh [b]Scratch It rewards[/b]
• 1 brand-new [b]quest with achievement[/b][/p][p]
[/p][h2]🩸 A New Project – BLEEDOUT[/h2][p]We’re currently working on [b]BLEEDOUT[/b], a hybrid Roguelike x Idle game.
Soon, an exclusive in-game item will be added to Idle Life that grants you [b]BLEEDOUT for free once it releases[/b].
This reward will be strictly limited – only a handful of players will be able to claim it. 👀[/p][p]
[/p][p]But don’t worry: [b]Idle Life remains our main project[/b].
Our focus continues to be on making Idle Life bigger, better, and more fun – BLEEDOUT is simply a side project we’re building in parallel.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]⚔️ Sharper, cleaner, faster – and something new is bleeding in.[/h2][p]See you soon,
— The Dev Goblin 👹[/p]

notes.title: 🎶 Weekly Update #9 – Sounds, Fixes & More!
notes.notes:
[h1]🎶 Weekly Update #9 – Sounds, Fixes & More![/h1][p]This week we’re finally adding sound options to Idle Life – plus a round of bugfixes that smooth out some long-standing issues.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]🔊 New Settings[/h2][p]Two new options are now available in the Settings menu:
• [b]Notification Sound Settings[/b] – control the volume or disable quest and system notifications.
• [b]Background Sounds Settings[/b] – yes, finally! Background music has been added. It’s not the fanciest soundtrack in the world, but it’s 100% copyright free and self-made – so it’s here to stay.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h2][p]We’ve squashed a variety of issues this week:
• Fixed a bug where daily quests would sometimes not refresh at midnight.
• Fixed inventory tooltips overlapping on smaller resolutions.
• Fixed mining progress bars not resetting properly after switching tabs.
• Fixed scratch cards occasionally giving no reward at all.
• Fixed casino token prices not updating after daily reset.
• Fixed UI scaling issues in the shop when resizing the game window.
• Fixed achievements not triggering immediately after quest completion.
• Fixed crafting recipes showing duplicate icons in rare cases.
• Fixed arena monsters not displaying correct stats in certain fights.[/p][p]
[/p][p]That’s all for this week – small but important changes to make everything feel smoother and more alive.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]🎵 The sound of progress is here.[/h2][p]See you soon,
— The Dev Goblin 👹[/p]

[/p][p]That’s all for this week – short and sweet. See you in the next patch![/p][p]

— The Dev Goblin 👹[/p]

notes.title: 📦 Idle Life – Weekly Update #7
notes.notes:
[h1]📦 Idle Life – Weekly Update #7[/h1][p]A new week, a new update! This one focuses on more customization, a few long-awaited features, and of course: lots of bug fixes.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]🗃️ Inventory Options[/h2][p]Inventory space is [b]limited by default[/b] and can be expanded through special items.
For players who prefer no limits, there’s now a [b]setting to disable inventory restrictions[/b].
⚠️ Keep in mind: disabling this will remove the usefulness of certain items that expand inventory space.
→ [b]Default is “Inventory Space: ON”[/b], and this also applies to all existing saves.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]🔔 Inventory Full Notification[/h2][p]If your inventory is full, you’ll now get a subtle notification so you don’t miss rewards or loot anymore.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]⚙️ Settings Menu [/h2][p]With more customization options coming in (languages, window sizes, inventory settings, etc.), we’ve introduced a [b]dedicated settings menu[/b].
Finally – all the tweaks in one place![/p][p]
[/p][h2]📜 Quest Update + Steam Achievements[/h2][p]We’ve linked quests directly to Steam achievements.
Once you [b]claim a quest[/b], you’ll receive the corresponding achievement on Steam within about a minute.
No more delays – instant recognition![/p][p]
[/p][h2]🐞 Bug Fixes – From A to Z[/h2][p]• Fixed a bug where mining progress bars wouldn’t reset correctly
• Fixed crafting recipes showing duplicate items in rare cases
• Fixed a visual issue where quest boxes overlapped on smaller resolutions
• Fixed a rare bug where workers stopped working after long idle sessions
• Fixed UI scaling issues in shop and arena menus
• …and plenty of smaller cleanups under the hood[/p][p]
[/p][p]Thanks again for sticking with Idle Life – your feedback and bug reports help us make each patch better than the last![/p][p]
[/p][h2]🔮 The inventory grows, the quests shine brighter.[/h2][p]See you soon,
— The Dev Goblin 👹[/p]

notes.title: 🧪 Weekly Update #3 – Quests Reborn & Scratch-Off Surprises!
notes.notes:
[h1]🧪 Weekly Update #3 – Quests Reborn & Scratch-Off Surprises![/h1]
[p]It’s official: what started as a BETA sneak peek is now this week’s full update! The quest system has been reworked, new rewards are in, and a whole new type of item awaits brave adventurers. Oh, and by the way — full Controller and Steam Deck support is here. Time to sit back and click... with style.[/p]

[h2]📜 Quest System Rework – Now Live![/h2]
[p]The foundation of the game has shifted: Quests have been completely reimagined.
• [b]Daily Quests:[/b] The full set of [b]14 unique daily objectives[/b] is now available.
• [b]Reward overhaul:[/b] No more samey Shard rewards – welcome the [b]Scratch It[/b].

Each day offers something new to strive for – some simple, some surprising, and some… just plain weird.[/p]

[h2]🎁 New Reward Type – “Scratch It”[/h2]
[p]Ever wanted to rub a digital lottery ticket?
[b]Scratch It[/b] is a new randomized reward system – a ticket-like item with 5 hidden spots. You might uncover:
• Upgrade Shards
• Rare crafting mats
• [b]New workers[/b]
• Or… something else entirely 👀

Available as primary rewards for most quests.[/p]

[h2]🔔 Notification System – Now Default[/h2]
[p]You’ll now get helpful messages in the corner when:
• Workers stop working
• You’re starving / dehydrated
• Something malfunctions

It’s simple, subtle, and keeps you in the loop without disrupting gameplay.[/p]

[h2]💠 Enchantment Spotlight – Looting[/h2]
[p]A new enchantment joins the pool:
• [b]Looting:[/b] Gain more resources from defeated enemies.
If you’re the type to take everything that isn’t nailed down… this one’s for you.[/p]

[h2]🎮 Controller & Steam Deck Support[/h2]
[p]We’ve added full Controller Support — every screen, menu, and mechanic can now be navigated with your gamepad.
Also: the game is now fully playable on the Steam Deck!
Sit back and idle like a champion — anywhere.[/p]

[h2]💬 Got Feedback? Share It![/h2]
[p]This system is still fresh – we want to hear from you.
Tell us which quests you love, what drops feel exciting, and what you'd like to see added.
→ Feedback via [b]Steam comments[/b] or [b]Discord[/b]![/p]

[h2]📬 Still Want Beta Access?[/h2]
[p]The BETA is still available for testing upcoming mechanics:
• Right-click Idle Life in Steam → Properties → Betas
• Enter the beta password
• Don’t have it? Join the Discord:[/p]
[p][url="https://discord.gg/HV38zvQZXz"]https://discord.gg/HV38zvQZXz[/url][/p]
[p]→ Or leave a comment here to receive it via Steam DM![/p]

[h2]🎯 It’s scratchin’ time – now from the couch.[/h2]
[p]See you soon,
— The Dev Goblin 👹[/p]

notes.title: 🧪 BETA Update – Quest System & Notifications!

[h1]🧪 BETA Update – Quest System & Notifications![/h1][p]Ready to peek behind the curtain? A brand-new BETA version of Idle Life is now live – and it's packed with reworks, experiments, and features that need your feedback. [/p][p]
[/p][h2]📜 Quest System Rework – Phase 1[/h2][p]The long-awaited Quest Rework is here – starting with a full overhaul of how quests work internally, plus a new system for [b]Daily Quests[/b].  
For testing purposes, only [b]2 daily quests[/b] are currently available – but [b]14 unique variations[/b] are planned for the full release this Sunday!

This is just the beginning – we’re rebuilding the system from the ground up to make quests more dynamic, more rewarding, and better structured for long-term play.

[/p][h2]🔔 Notification System[/h2][p]Introducing small but mighty alerts in the lower right corner of your screen.  
• Worker stopped working? Notification.  
• Starving? Dying of thirst? Notification.  
• Something broke? You guessed it: notification.

This new system is here to keep you informed without interrupting your flow.

[/p][h2]🧪 New Enchantment: Looting[/h2][p]A new enchantment is now testable:  
• [b]Looting:[/b] Gain more resources from enemies you defeat.  
Perfect for greedy players and ruthless grinders.

[/p][h2]🚪 How to Join the Beta[/h2][p][b]Step 1:[/b] Right-click Idle Life in your Steam library → Properties → Betas  
[b]Step 2:[/b] Enter the beta access password  
[b]Step 3:[/b] Restart the game and enjoy testing!

[/p][h2]🔑 How to Get the Beta Password[/h2][p]There are two ways to unlock it:

[b]1. Join our Discord:[/b]  
The password is pinned in the rules channel.  
→ [b]https://discord.gg/HV38zvQZXz[/b]

[b]2. No Discord? No problem![/b]  
Just comment on this update and accept the friend request from us on Steam.  
Once you're added, [b]check your DMs[/b] – you'll receive the password within [b]12 hours[/b].  
Yes, really.

[/p][h2]⚙️ This is BETA – Things May Break[/h2][p]Some features are unfinished. Others might behave weirdly. That’s the point!  
We need your feedback to polish things up before the public release on [b]Sunday[/b].

[/p][h2]📬 Let us know what you think![/h2][p]You can leave feedback in the Discord or as comments here on Steam – we read all of it.  
Bug reports, thoughts, ideas – hit us with everything you’ve got.

[/p][h2]🧭 A new quest begins – and you're invited.[/h2][p]See you soon,  [/p][p]— The Dev Goblin 👹   [/p]

notes.title: 🔮 Weekly Update #2 – Enchantments, Arenas & Offline Chaos 🔮 - Month #1
notes.notes:
[h1]🔮 Weekly Update #2 – Enchantments, Arenas & Offline Chaos 🔮[/h1][p]Remember when enchantments were just boring +5 stats? Not anymore. This week we’re reshaping how power works, how crafting works, and how you spend your life in the arena. Get comfy. This one’s loaded. [/p][p]
[/p][h2]✨ Enchantment Stuff[/h2][p]Sick of enchantments that just sit there and flex their numbers? Same. That’s why we’ve rewritten the system from scratch.  
All old enchantments have been removed (rip), and replaced with something... real. Functional. Spicy.  
No more "+10 damage" and calling it a day. New enchantments now have [b]actual gameplay effects[/b].  Also: you can now enchant items using a new [b]XP system[/b]. Defeat monsters, gain XP, spend it on enchantments. Yes, it’s like Minecraft. No, Mojang doesn’t get paid for this.  [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]⚔️ Arena Rework[/h2][p]The arena has been rebuilt from the ground up. Expect more tension, more tools, and way more reasons to enter battle.  
• [b]New Arena Inventory:[/b] Completely separate from your regular gear  
• [b]Summoning Rituals:[/b] Choose the enemy you want to fight, if you dare  
• [b]Search Random:[/b] Spin the monster wheel and face whatever shows up  
• [b]New Monster:[/b] It bites, it’s fast, and it hates you  
• [b]New Boss Group:[/b] Currently in development – coming very soon[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658041/bf19c5e883e69989a696c890aa72edcb0cfbc381.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]🧪 Crafting Rework[/h2][p]This one’s big. You can now craft the same item in multiple different ways.  
That means: more freedom, more discovery, and more ways to optimize your resources.  
Whether you're short on iron or drowning in slime – the system can now adapt.  
Also: [b]25+ new crafting recipes[/b] have been added. Some useful. Some risky. Some weird.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658041/ff5b683f6ce4e735fa07ca73a0693186de068cf2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]🏬 Shop Upgrade[/h2][p]A few small but welcome changes:  
• Visual improvements  
• Discounts now appear properly  
• Improved logic behind item rotations

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658041/8e726bd1dd325761dcffd73cc608aee870e743f5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]💤 Offline Earnings[/h2][p]You asked for it – it’s finally here.  
• [b]Steam Server Time:[/b] Earn up to 6 hours while you're away  
• [b]Local PC Time:[/b] Earn up to 3 hours without cloud sync  
Default is Steam time (for existing saves). You can change this in the new [b]Offline Settings[/b] menu.

[/p][h2]🌍 Language Support[/h2][p]• [b]Official Traditional Chinese Support[/b] added. Welcome to all new players!

[/p][h2]⛏️ New Items & Discoveries[/h2][p]There’s more to this update than just big systems. We've added a ton of new items to spice up your journey – [b]17 in total[/b]. Some are rare, some are useful, and some... are just plain weird. You'll find them across mining, crafting, rituals and combat.  

Experiment. Collect. Break things. Then figure out how they work.  
You’re not supposed to know what they all do — that’s the fun part.  

• [b]2 New Mining Resources:[/b] Deep in the mines – if you're lucky  
• [b]17 New Items:[/b] Scattered across multiple systems – happy hunting

[/p][h2]🐞 Fixes & Stability[/h2][p]• Enchantment UI scaling fixed  
• Upgrade screen layout adjustments  
• Arena equipment bugs resolved  
• Anvil upgrade stability improved  
• Auto-harvest in garden works again  
• Shop loading issues on new saves fixed  
• Volcanbic Depths terrain bugs patched  
• Shop item display logic corrected

[/p][h2]💬 Join the Community[/h2][p]Have feedback on the new enchantments? Found a weird recipe? Named your arena monster “Greg the Unkillable”?  
Join the community, share your builds, break the meta or just vibe.  
[b]Discord:[/b] [url="https://discord.gg/HV38zvQZXz"]https://discord.gg/HV38zvQZXz[/url]
[/p][p]
[/p][h2]⚔️ Stay strong – the Arena hungers.[/h2][p]See you soon,
— The Dev Goblin 👹[/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Weekly Update #1 – The First Steps Begin! 🛠️
notes.notes:
[h1]🛠️ Weekly Update #1 – The First Steps Begin! 🛠️[/h1]
[p]Welcome back, Idlers!  
Our very first weekly update is here – small but mighty. This patch focuses on smoothing out the gameplay experience and adding some quality-of-life features for both new and returning players.[/p]

[h2]💬 Got Feedback? We’d love to hear it![/h2]
[p]How do you like the game so far?  
Let us know by:  
• Writing a [b]Steam review[/b]  
• Starting a [b]discussion[/b] right here on Steam  
• Joining our [b]Discord community[/b] and chatting with us directly  
👉 [url=https://discord.gg/HV38zvQZXz]https://discord.gg/HV38zvQZXz[/url]  
Your input helps shape the future of Idle Life!  
[/p]

[h2]📦 What’s New?[/h2]
[p]• 🧰 [b]New Useful Items:[/b] A handful of new things to collect, craft and use!  
• 🎨 [b]Reworked Main Menu:[/b] No more chaos – just slick, clean design.  
• 📖 [b]Mini-Wiki Added:[/b] A small, helpful wiki now lives inside the game! It’ll expand over time to help players learn quickly and intuitively.  
• ⚖️ [b]Item & Crafting Balancing:[/b] We’ve reworked several item requirements – no more 15 bundles of grass for one rope!  
• 🐛 [b]Bugfixes, Bugfixes, Bugfixes![/b]  
  • Fixed items disappearing  
  • Fixed items/craftings not unlocking  
  • Fixed shop not resetting  
  • Fixed day not starting  
  • Fixed menu not loading  
  • Fixed game not loading from main menu  
  • Fixed performance spikes caused by broken workers  
  • Improved overall performance (2–7% boost across key areas)  
[/p]

[h2]❓ FAQ – What’s the goal of this game anyway? 🤔[/h2]
[p][b]🧭 What’s the long-term vision for Idle Life?[/b]  
Idle Life isn’t meant to be a one-and-done game. We're building an [i]Idle-Crafting experience[/i] with a reason to log in every day — whether it’s to progress, craft, loot, or just vibe. [/p]

[p][b]📅 How often will updates drop?[/b]  
• [b]Weekly:[/b] 1 content/fix update at the end of every week  
• [b]Monthly:[/b] 1 [b]major update[/b] with new features (like Arena reworks or Weekly Quests)  
[/p]

[h2]🔧 Currently in Development:[/h2]
[p]• 🥊 [b]Arena Rework[/b] – We’re rebuilding the Arena from the ground up.  
  → ETA: Next week’s monthly update 🔥  
[/p]

[h2]🧠 Stay idle, stay clever – and always craft responsibly![/h2]
[p]Until next week,  
— The Dev Goblin 👹[/p]

 [/p][h2]🛠️ Fixes & Improvements[/h2][h3]📛 Proper Game Identity[/h3][p]   🪪 [b]Task Manager Name:[/b] The game finally shows up as [b]IdleLife – An Idle Game[/b], not “UnrealGame”.
